text:
**Review Result**

Overall quality score: **4/10**. The code is small and readable, but the repo is not reproducible as checked in: the advertised tiny end-to-end demo fails because required story source files are missing. I would **not approve this as-is**.

Validation performed: `pytest` in an isolated temp env produced **6 passed, 1 failed**; the failure is `test_tiny_end_to_end` at extraction. `extract --tiny` fails with missing `data/stories/manifest.json`. `validate-contexts` and `steer-prefs` only worked when pointed at the committed prebuilt `outputs/tiny_demo` artifacts.

**Issues**

| Severity | File | Lines | Issue |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| high | [emovec/extract.py](/work/emovec/extract.py:23) | 23-27 | Tiny extraction still requires external story files, so the advertised CPU demo is not reproducible from the repo. |
| high | [config.yaml](/work/config.yaml:7) | 7-9 | Default `stories_dir` points to `data/stories`, but that tree contains no manifest or story files. |
| high | [tests/test_integration_tiny.py](/work/tests/test_integration_tiny.py:12) | 12 | The end-to-end test currently fails on missing `data/stories/manifest.json`. |
| high | [emovec/validate_contexts.py](/work/emovec/validate_contexts.py:21) | 21-28 | Validation trusts the current config backend instead of checking artifact backend/dimensions from the manifest. |
| high | [emovec/steer_prefs.py](/work/emovec/steer_prefs.py:26) | 26-36 | Preference validation has the same artifact/backend mismatch risk and can produce invalid comparisons or shape failures. |
| medium | [outputs/tiny_demo/vectors/manifest.json](/work/outputs/tiny_demo/vectors/manifest.json:25) | 25-66 | Committed generated artifacts reference a source manifest that is not present, masking broken extraction. |
| medium | [emovec/model.py](/work/emovec/model.py:243) | 243-250 | HuggingFace activation extraction has no truncation or max-token guard, making local inputs capable of causing OOM. |
| medium | [emovec/model.py](/work/emovec/model.py:196) | 196-214 | Full model loading lacks device-map/low-memory/offline/auth handling, so the default backend is fragile for real use. |
| medium | [emovec/model.py](/work/emovec/model.py:226) | 226-240 | If tokenizer offsets are unavailable, steering falls back to all prompt tokens instead of activity tokens only. |
| low | [emovec/vector_ops.py](/work/emovec/vector_ops.py:16) | 16-32 | `pca_components_for_variance(..., threshold=0)` returns one component even though zero variance requires none. |
| low | [emovec/config.py](/work/emovec/config.py:75) | 75-78 | Config loading has no schema validation, so malformed values fail later with less actionable errors. |

Estimated rewrite/significant-change size: **220 LOC**. Most of that is restoring/generating source story data, adding artifact compatibility checks, hardening HF execution, and improving tests/config validation.

issues.description: Tiny extraction still requires external story files, so the advertised CPU demo is not reproducible from the repo.
Default stories_dir points to data/stories, but that tree contains no manifest or story files.
The end-to-end test currently fails on missing data/stories/manifest.json.
Validation trusts the current config backend instead of checking artifact backend and dimensions from the manifest.
Preference validation has the same artifact/backend mismatch risk and can produce invalid comparisons or shape failures.
Committed generated artifacts reference a source manifest that is not present, masking broken extraction.
HuggingFace activation extraction has no truncation or max-token guard, making local inputs capable of causing OOM.
Full model loading lacks device-map, low-memory, offline, and auth handling, so the default backend is fragile for real use.
If tokenizer offsets are unavailable, steering falls back to all prompt tokens instead of activity tokens only.
pca_components_for_variance with threshold 0 returns one component even though zero variance requires none.
Config loading has no schema validation, so malformed values fail later with less actionable errors.
